rules: Zero black box: write a 30-line version of every library call you use
1-7-30 revision: re-solve failed problems the next day, after 7 days and after 30 days
Paper to code from December: one paper every two weeks, README + minimal notebook
Build in public: push clean code every Sunday
Exam Light Mode: only 1 DSA problem a morning, protect the CGPA
